To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the hard side of ITG can be described by one model, the soft side by a combination of models.
the ITG Maturity Model for hard ITG consists of 6 focus areas and that the ITG MM for soft ITG consists of a set of 7 focus areas with different maturity models.
the hard ITG MM of COBIT 4.1 is the best choice, but that soft ITG is best measured using a combination of focus area models.
In summary, our research is concerned with
ITG maturity and its measurement.
the development of ITG MMs that are applicable for both hard and soft ITG.
the development of an ITG MM that is applicable for both hard and soft ITG.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Delphi study resulted in a model that is appropriate for hard IT governance and that soft governance needs more research and development.
the Delphi study resulted in one MM for hard ITG and a number of models for soft ITG.
a combination of focus area models is the most suitable approach to develop an IT governance maturity model.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a focus area MM is a useful approach to measure the maturity of hard ITG.
the ITG maturity of an organization is the highest level of maturity reached in the different focus areas of the organization.
a combination of hard and soft ITG is needed to achieve high ITG maturity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
ITG maturity models are not a single entity, but need to be adapted to the specific situation of the organization.
the soft side of ITG is a neglected area of research and needs more attention.
the Delphi method is a valuable tool to develop a MM.
